results.criterion: For a marker representing multiple calls, CSR is 100 × successful calls divided by successful, setup-failed, operator-answered, no-service, and invalid calls; dropped calls are excluded and a zero denominator produces zero. Each MOS value is weighted by that metric's own valid sample count, and Estimated MOS uses its dedicated values rather than an average of Downlink and Uplink MOS.
steps_taken: Started at launcher, configured Automobile Call, selected a point and inspected genuine GET /api/platform/automobile/call/points and POST /api/platform/automobile/call/cluster-details and /test-analysis responses (all HTTP 200).
Captured actual detail state.
Restored original Ping and closed created tab.
results.reason: Calculation prerequisites are missing: observed HTTP 200 Call point/cluster responses do not expose counts for successful, setup-failed, operator-answered, no-service, invalid and dropped calls or separate valid sample counts for every MOS metric. The selected aggregate resolved to single PointID 132047844, with Downlink/Uplink MOS null and Estimated MOS 4.4. A known multi-call denominator/weighting fixture and zero-denominator fixture are required.

results.criterion: The default CSR legend uses green #31AA4F for 95–100%, light green #86BE42 for 90–<95%, yellow #FCBF1A for 85–<90%, red #E61733 for 80–<85%, and dark red #AE1A32 for 0–<80%; exact boundaries use the higher band.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and configured Automobile Call with default CSR.
Opened Edit Legend and inspected actual colour, label, value and limit controls.
Captured editor, cancelled without edits and restored Ping.
results.reason: Default CSR editor colours match #31AA4F, #86BE42, #FCBF1A, #E61733 and #AE1A32, with labels >=95, >=90, >=85, >=80 and <80 and 0–100 input limits. Loaded points have only CSR 0, 50 and 100; no known 80/85/90/95 boundary points were available to verify runtime boundary assignment.

results.criterion: Each default MOS legend uses dark red #AE1A32 for 1–<2, yellow #FCBF1A for 2–<3, light green #86BE42 for 3–<4, and green #31AA4F for 4–5 inclusive; exact internal boundaries use the higher band.
steps_taken: Started at launcher and configured Call.
Switched to Downlink MOS, Uplink MOS and Estimated MOS; independently opened each editor and read colour values, labels and limits.
Cancelled each editor, captured final Estimated MOS legend and restored Ping.
results.reason: All three MOS editors have expected colours and descending labels 4 ≤ MOS ≤ 5, 3 ≤ MOS < 4, 2 ≤ MOS < 3 and 1 ≤ MOS < 2, with 1–5 input bounds. Valid Downlink/Uplink and exact 2/3/4/5 boundary fixtures were unavailable, so runtime classification and exactly-5 behaviour remain unverified.

results.criterion: When the selected MOS metric has no valid samples, it is unavailable rather than shown as zero or replaced by another metric; values outside its bands use the white, initially hidden Out of Threshold category, with no separate Not Tested category.

results.reason: Selected Call record shows MOS Downlink and MOS Uplink N/A while Estimated MOS is 4.4. Downlink colouring hides the unavailable markers instead of displaying substituted values. Out of Threshold is white and initially hidden, and no Not Tested category appears. A known valid out-of-range MOS fixture was unavailable to verify that branch.

reviewSummary: Manual focused follow-up on 3 November 2026 supplements the original cycle-002 attempt without resetting it. 9/21 criteria passed; 1 directly failed, 1 blocked and 10 unverified. Missing marker-size editing is confirmed. Aggregate calculation fixtures remain unavailable, and the identified boundary, restoration, sorting and error-branch coverage gaps remain open. Existing valid passes were preserved; this is not a new independent full review.
